4 امار السِّنَانَ فِى المَطْعَونِ [He made the spearhead to move from side to side in the person pierced]. (A.) امارت الرِّيحُ الغُبَارَ The wind
made the dust to go to and fro: or raised the dust. (M, K.) ―
-b2- امار الدَّمَ He made the blood to run or flow; (T, S, * IKtt, Msb;) as also ↓ مَارَهُ , (IKtt, Msb,) inf. n. مَيْرٌ. (IKtt. [as in the TA; but this seems to be a mistake for مَوْرٌ.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
